authority: user requested ignoring inner metric and using outer search tools only
primary_metric: project-domain citation rate over the fixed 15 queries and 4 equally weighted search engines
tool_failure_policy: Require 60 valid responses for automatic ranking; also report scheduled, valid, matched-valid results.
inner_role: ignored for candidate ranking and promotion; historical inner results are retained only for audit
history_policy: Preserve discarded/tied candidate commits and patches for deliberate reuse and combination experiments.
promotion: Never assign a live metric to an unpublished candidate or substitute R5 production results for R6.
